1.description: [Pending Restart] Fizzle and Rebuke are now usable while shapeshifted.

7.description: [Bloodsail Captain] Captain's Resolve passive buff will now be visible in your buff bar. This will make it more clear when you meet the requirements.
[Bloodsail Captain] Fixed an issue where Stagger would stop working. Stagger should now always work for Captains while Swashbuckling and if you know Rank 3 Tactical Mastery. (Pending Restart)
[Dark Ranger] Fixed an issue where using an invulnerability could cause you to no longer generate Dark Arrows.
[Pending restart] Fixed an issue where some healing spells from Worldforged enchants were useable in Moonkin Form.
[Bloodsail Captain] Fixed an issue where thread modifiers on Hammer the Gap and Panache were missing. These spells will now deal the intended amount of threat.
[Pending restart] The Mana Fiend ability Manacharged Strike now properly scales with attack power in addition to spell damage.
[Dark Ranger] Fixed an issue where Shadow Artillery was dealing higher base damage at lower levels than intended. The damage at max level remains unchanged.
[Cryotherapist] Cryotherapy heal will now prioritize players as the heal target first.
[Vampire Lord] Unholy Light will now properly heal your Beacon of Shadow target. (Pending Restart)
[Vampire Lord] Fixed an issue where the Vampiric Embrace transform Vampire Lord was not requiring Vampiric Embrace to be learned.

Thunderstruck now increases the damage of your Thunder Clap by 5% (3% versus players) of your bonus spell damage. Also fixed an issue where Thunderstruck incorrectly was increasing the attack power coefficient of Thunder Clap.
Sparing No Rod now increases the damage of your Hammer of the Righteous by 3% of your bonus spell damage.
Voodoo Power now increases the damage of your Lava Lash and Stormstrike by 4% of your bonus spell damage.
Secret of the Farstriders now increases the spell damage coefficient of your Arcane Shot by 15% (up from 12%) and Explosive Shot by 7% (up from 2.5%).
Stab in the Dark now increases the attack power coefficient of your Shadow Bolt and Seed of Corrpution direct damage by 15%, up from 7%.
Preacher's Curl now increases the attack power coefficient of your Smite and Holy Fire direct damage by 15%, up from 5%.
Don't Make Me Angry now increases the attack power coefficient of your Wrath and Starfire by 20%, up from 7%.
Cryokinesis now increases the attack power coefficient of your Cone of Cold by 25%, up from 10%.
Double the Pain now increases the attack power coefficient of your Searing Pain by 20%, up from 8%.

0.description: Fixed an issue where Razor Claws was not proccing when you used Claw. [Pending Restart]
Increased Threat from Dark Apotheosis
Offering Key is now obtainable on Area 52
Worldforged Key Fragements are now obtainable from TBC Callboard Caches
Corrected Tooltip on Harbinger of Flame it was increasing Fire damage by 5% not 3% as the tooltip claimed.
[Requires Launcher Update] Doubled the character limit for a build's description in the Hero Architect
Increased Co-efficient from Exorcism to 25% Spell Power from 14% and 25% Attack Power from 20%.
Increased Co-efficient of Hammer of Wrath to 22% Spell Power from 14% and 22% Attack Power from 20%.

[Righteous Vengeance] - Righteous Vengeance now deals 8/16/25% of the damage dealt from critical hits over the duration down from 15/30/45%, if you are in Primary Stat Stength allocation this effect is now doubled to 16/32/50.
[Razor Claws] - Now increases the Rip and Rake damage done by 30%, down from 35%.
[Razor Claws] - Reduced the global cool down of Bloodthirst by 33% while Razor Claws is active.
[Razor Claws] - Reimplemented the Razor Claws buff, this buff effect increases your physical damage done by 2% and your Bloodthirst damage by 8%. This effect stacks up to three times.
Issue where Seal of Light was not healing you for the correct amount has been fixed. [Pending Restart]
Issue where Power Surge was not being procced by Invocation and other Arcane Channels has been fixed. [Pending Restart]

[Pending Restart] - Raid Caches are now available from raids! Raid Caches allow you to have a chance to select a stat type of an item you'd like to obtain. Raid Caches drop from every single previous Raid Tier Boss (scaling with difficulty up to mythic, ascended currently drops mythic caches). This feature is live on both AREA-52 and THRALL

1.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Exorcism could consume both the Art of War proc and the haste portion of Holy Specializations capstone.
[Vampire Lord] These changes and bug fixes will result in a significant increase to healing output and quality of life. (Pending Restart)
[Vampire Lord] Vampiric Bond duration increased from 10 seconds to 12 seconds. This will smooth out the rotation flow and ensure you are casting more shadow spells between Unholy Prayers.
[Vampire Lord] Beacon of Shadow can be cast while moving now.
[Vampire Lord] Beacon of Shadow Shadowbolt healing has been increased from 10% to 15%.
[Vampire Lord] Fixed an issue where only one Vampire Lord could apply Beacon of Shadow in a group. You can now have vampire parties.
[Vampire Lord] The healing received buff from Vampiric Bond has been increased from 100% to 125%.
[Vampire Lord] Fixed an issue where Vampiric Bond was not always applying (this resulted in a significant healing loss)
[Cryotherapist] This bug fix will result in approximately 250% increased healing on the tank and 500% increased aoe healing to the party (Pending Restart).
[Cryotherapist] Fixed an issue where Cryotherapy was only healing for 2% of the damage done. It will now correctly heal for 5% as the tooltip states. (Pending Restart).
[Cryotherapist] Fixed an issue where Greater Heal and Flash Heal was not applying Lesser Frozen Light.
[Pending Restart] Arcane Mind now increases the duration of Alter Time by 0.66/1.33/2 sec, changed from 1/2/3 sec.
[Pending Restart] Retaliation no longer requires Battle Stance to be used.
[Pending Restart] Devastation talent has a new Capstone: While Burning Rush is active, the cast time of your Destruction spells is reduced by 15% and you take 80% reduced damage from Burning Rush.
[Pending Restart] Burning Rush no longer has a global cooldown. While active you can now cast Fire spells while moving.

[New Item] Soulsong Crystal is a new healing trinket added to Firemaw

3.description: Implemented addon auto-updating. Once addon has updated, you will see a toast at top right.
[Launcher] Implemented ability to launch different versions of client at same time instead of only limiting to one. (ie PTR and Live can now be launched at the same time).

2.description: Increased the size of Lei Shen's Relic objects slightly.
The denizen's of Quel'Lithien Lodge can now be attacked by either faction.
[Vestments of Transendence - 8 Set] Triggered effect's healing over time's scaling has a been brought in line with other 8-set bonuses' power level, had much higher scalings than intended.

1.description: [Pending Restart] Earthquake Stun now lasts for 2.5 sec, changed from 3 sec.
Mana Shield now absorbs for 10% less while in 1v1 arena.
[Pending Restart] You now gain 33% of the attack power of Rockbiter while your Primary Stat is Spirit or Intellect.

Fixed a tooltip issue where Bloodsail Captain incorrectly stated Blurred Blade granted 8% chance to Parry. Blurred Blade grants 8% Damage Reduction against Magical Attacks.
[Steward of Eternity] Corrected the tooltip of Align, which incorrectly stated that its healing is increased on targets that are already Aligned.
[Steward of Eternity] The Worldforged Location Tip "Chromie has been watching for a time." will now properly display on the spell. (requires spell patch)
Fixed an issue where some of the new rare Worldforged enchants did not display properly in the Mystic Enchanting UI.
[Lei Shen's Legacy] New Legendary Worldforged Enchant is now available to be discovered in the world.

[Pending Restart] - Rare World Forged fighter mystic enchantments will now also give Ranged Attack Power.
[Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where Conflagrate was dealing too low damage (56% of Immolate's total) instead of the intended (70%) of Immolate's Total Damage post Chapter 2 release.
